title: 蘇格蘭教授 James Blyth 以布帆風機發電，點亮自家小屋

summary: 1887 年 7 月，格拉斯哥 Anderson's College（Strathclyde 大學前身）教授 James Blyth 在家鄉 Marykirk 度假小屋的花園裝設布帆風機，用發出的電替蓄電池充電；「蘇格蘭工程名人堂」說它在和風下能點亮十顆 25 伏特燈泡，這間小屋是世界上第一棟以風力電力照明的房子，系統運轉了 25 年。Scottish Places 與維基百科都指出，這比美國的 Charles F. Brush 1887 年冬天建成自動運轉風機早了幾個月。

In July 1887 James Blyth, professor at Anderson's College in Glasgow (a forerunner of the University of Strathclyde), set up a cloth-sailed wind turbine in the garden of his holiday cottage in Marykirk and used its electricity to charge accumulators. The Scottish Engineering Hall of Fame says it could light ten 25-volt bulbs in a moderate breeze, that the cottage was the first house in the world lit by wind-generated electricity, and that the system ran for 25 years. Scottish Places and Wikipedia note that this came some months before the American Charles F. Brush built his automatically operated turbine in the winter of 1887.

summary: 1957 年，工程師 Johannes Juul 為電力公司 SEAS 建造的 Gedser 風機啟用：200 kW、三葉片、24 公尺混凝土塔，交流電直接送進電網。丹麥科普網站 videnskab.dk 的研究者專文說它運轉十餘年沒有大修，一直供電給 SEAS 的電網，其設計原則後來成為今日三葉百萬瓦級風機的重要起點；維基百科稱它是丹麥第一部大型風機，建造時有馬歇爾計畫支援。

summary: 海洋風力發電公司（上緯投控子公司）2017 年 4 月 28 日取得經濟部核發的台灣首張海上風力發電機組電業執照；第一階段 2 部 4 MW 示範風機合計 8 MW，2016 年 10 月在苗栗竹南外海安裝完成，是台灣首次商業運轉的離岸風機。環境資訊中心報導這兩部風機耗資約新台幣 40 億元；第二階段另設 20 部風機，其後成為台灣首座商業規模離岸風場。

On 28 April 2017 Formosa 1 (a Swancor subsidiary) received from the Ministry of Economic Affairs Taiwan's first electricity licence for offshore wind turbines. Its first phase, two 4 MW demonstration turbines (8 MW) installed off Zhunan, Miaoli in October 2016, became Taiwan's first commercially operating offshore turbines. The Environmental Information Center reported that the two machines cost about NT$4 billion; the 20-turbine second phase later made it Taiwan's first commercial-scale offshore farm.

title: 機艙維修時起火，兩名技師重傷

summary: 12 月 19 日下午，Gols 與 Zurndorf 之間一部 Energie Burgenland Windkraft 營運的風機在機艙維修時起火，兩名技師重傷，自行下塔後由直升機送往維也納與格拉茨醫院；火點在 90 多 m 高、無法滅火，機艙外罩燒毀、部分掉落，周圍 500 m 封鎖。Energie Burgenland 初步研判為短路（APA／vienna.at 2017-12-19）。2019 年 3 月一名 41 歲電工因此案在 Eisenstadt 受審並獲轉向處分（tt.com 2019-03-15）。

On the afternoon of 19 December a turbine between Gols and Zurndorf operated by Energie Burgenland Windkraft caught fire during maintenance in the nacelle; the two technicians were seriously injured, managed to climb down and were flown to hospitals in Vienna and Graz. The seat of the fire at over 90 m could not be fought, the nacelle cladding burnt and parts fell, and a 500 m cordon was set. Energie Burgenland's preliminary view was a short circuit (APA / vienna.at 19 Dec 2017). In March 2019 a 41-year-old electrician was tried in Eisenstadt over the fire and given a diversion (tt.com 15 Mar 2019).

title: Carmen 暴風中服役 13 年的風機倒塌，塔架斷成兩截

summary: 1 月 1 日 Carmen 暴風襲擊法國西部時，Vendée 省 Bouin 風場一部 62 m 高、260 噸的風機倒塌，塔架斷成兩截、碎片散落大片範圍，該機 2003 年投運、已經歷多次暴風，同場其餘風機無恙（The Local 2018-01-02；Keraunos）。法國工業事故資料庫 ARIA 的紀錄（經 Deux-Sèvres 省政府公開的風場危害研究轉載）寫明原因：暴風中重新定位風機時資料判讀錯誤，使轉子加速過快。

On 1 January, as Storm Carmen hit western France, a 62 m, 260-tonne turbine at the Bouin wind farm in Vendée toppled, its tower breaking in two and debris spreading over a wide area; the machine dated from 2003 and had survived many storms, and the farm's other turbines were unharmed (The Local 2 Jan 2018; Keraunos). The ARIA industrial-accident record (reproduced in a wind-farm hazard study published by the Deux-Sèvres prefecture) gives the cause: a data-interpretation error while repositioning the turbine in the storm let the rotor accelerate too fast.

On 22 June 2018 the Ministry of Economic Affairs opened the bids in Taiwan's first offshore wind price auction: 12 farms of 7 developers competed for 1,664 MW, won by Hai Long 2 (232 MW at NT$2.2245/kWh), Hai Long 3, Greater Changhua 2 (south-west) and Greater Changhua 4 (north-west) for completion in 2025, at NT$2.2245–2.5481/kWh. The prices were far below that year's feed-in tariff of about NT$5.8/kWh; the Control Yuan later asked the ministry to review the gap, and the ministry replied in December that the scheme saved on power purchases. summary: 4 月 8 日根室市昆布盛風場 6 號機因風車軸承損壞引發機艙火災；經產省新能源發電設備事故對應工作小組 2019-11-19 審議後，2020-02-17 向全國設置者發出要求：本案是電氣事業法規定的法定點檢未適當執行、導致主軸承破損、主軸偏移而至機艙火災，僅靠溫度感測器監視無法掌握軸承損傷，應以年度點檢確認潤滑脂狀態（經濟產業省，2020-02-17）。

On 8 April the nacelle of turbine 6 at the Konbumori Wind Farm in Nemuro caught fire after its main bearing failed; after METI's working group on new-energy generation accidents reviewed the case on 19 Nov 2019, METI issued a request to all owners on 17 Feb 2020 stating that the statutory inspections under the Electricity Business Act had not been carried out properly, which led to the bearing failure, shaft displacement and nacelle fire, that temperature sensors alone had not revealed the bearing damage, and that grease condition should be checked at annual inspections (METI, 17 Feb 2020).

summary: 8 月 9 日輸電線路遭雷擊後，Hornsea One（當時仍在安裝、174×7 MW）與 Little Barford 燃氣電廠都未保持併網，合計出力驟降觸發低頻卸載，逾百萬用戶停電、鐵路大亂；Ofgem 調查認定兩者違反併網規範，Hornsea One Ltd 與 RWE 各自願支付 450 萬英鎊（Ofgem 2020-01-03）。

summary: 10 月 5 日（星期一）晚上 7 時 30 分左右，試運轉中的 336 MW Dundonnell 風場一部運轉中的 Vestas V150-4.2 MW 風機 73 m 長、約 15 t 的葉片自 115 m 高的輪轂脫落墜地，全場 80 部機組停機；業主 Tilt Renewables 聲明無人受傷、其他財產與風機無損，將與 Vestas 做根因分析（RenewEconomy，2020-10-07）。後續報導指葉片與輪轂的螺栓鬆脫。

At about 19:30 on Monday 5 October a 73 m, roughly 15 t blade of an operating Vestas V150-4.2 MW turbine at the 336 MW Dundonnell wind farm, then in commissioning, separated from the hub at about 115 m and fell to the ground, halting all 80 turbines; owner Tilt Renewables said there were no injuries and no damage to other property or turbines and that a root-cause analysis would be done with Vestas (RenewEconomy, 7 Oct 2020). Later reports attributed the fall to loosened blade-to-hub bolts.

summary: 1 月 4 日 Zeewolde 市 Eemmeerdijk 風場一部風機的上半段折斷，轉子、葉片與塔頂掉到堤防道路上，無人受傷；Vattenfall 隨即停下沿堤其餘 16 部風機，風場原已排定年內拆除。荷蘭基礎設施與水管理部 2023-10-17 致國會函引述 Vattenfall 委託的外部調查：維修中一個變槳油缸被固定，葉片無法順槳，強風下轉速過高、劇烈振動而失穩，機械煞車擋不住；老化、維修不足與金屬疲勞都不是原因。機組 1998 年安裝，為已倒閉 NedWind 製造的雙葉風機，荷蘭已無同型變槳系統的風機在運轉。

On 4 January the upper part of a turbine at the Eemmeerdijk wind farm in Zeewolde broke off; rotor, blades and tower top fell onto the dyke road and nobody was hurt. Vattenfall stopped the other 16 turbines along the dyke at once; the farm was already due for dismantling that year. The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management's letter to parliament of 17 Oct 2023 cites the external investigation commissioned by Vattenfall: a pitch cylinder had been fixed during maintenance so the blades could not feather, the rotor overspeeded in strong wind and the turbine became unstable through violent vibration, which the mechanical brake could not stop; ageing, deferred maintenance and metal fatigue played no role. The turbines were installed in 1998 by the now-defunct NedWind (two-blade machines) and no turbine with such a pitch system still operates in the Netherlands.

title: Fosen 案和解：Sør-Fosen 馴鹿牧民同意 Storheia 風場繼續運轉，Roan 隨後也達成協議
Fosen settlement: Sør-Fosen reindeer herders agree to Storheia's continued operation, followed by a Roan agreement
summary: 挪威最高法院 2021 年判定 Fosen 半島 Roan 與 Storheia 風場的許可侵害薩米馴鹿牧民的文化權利後，2023 年 2 月抗議者占領石油能源部大廳，政府 3 月 2 日向牧民道歉。2023 年 12 月，經調解，Sør-Fosen 牧區與 Fosen Vind 達成協議：Storheia 可在 25 年許可期內（至 2045 年）繼續運轉，牧民獲得經濟補償、額外牧地與許可期滿後再設風場的否決權；2024 年 3 月 6 日 Nord-Fosen 牧區也與 Roan Vind 達成類似協議（TU；挪威國家人權機構 NIM；Altinget）。

After Norway's Supreme Court ruled in 2021 that the licences for the Roan and Storheia wind farms on Fosen violated Sámi reindeer herders' cultural rights, protesters occupied the energy ministry's lobby in February 2023 and the government apologised to the herders on 2 March 2023. In December 2023 mediation produced an agreement between Sør-Fosen sijte and Fosen Vind: Storheia may keep operating for the 25-year licence period to 2045, and the herders receive financial compensation, additional grazing land and a veto over further wind power after the licence ends; on 6 March 2024 Nord-Fosen siida reached a similar agreement with Roan Vind (TU; Norwegian National Human Rights Institution; Altinget).

summary: 2025 年 4 月 16 日，美國內政部海洋能源管理局（BOEM）通知 Equinor 子公司 Empire Offshore Wind LLC，在 BOEM 完成審查前停止外大陸棚上的所有活動，紐約外海施工中的 Empire Wind 1 隨即停止海上施工；Equinor 表示將在 2025 年第一季財報揭露為期後事項。經與聯邦、州及市府官員溝通後，BOEM 撤回停工令，Equinor 2025 年 5 月 20 日 00:18（歐洲中部夏令時間，美東 5 月 19 日）宣布恢復施工（Equinor 新聞稿）。

On 16 April 2025 the US Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) notified Equinor's subsidiary Empire Offshore Wind LLC to halt all activities on the Outer Continental Shelf until BOEM had completed its review, and offshore construction of Empire Wind 1 off New York stopped; Equinor said the order would be disclosed as a subsequent event in its first-quarter 2025 report. After dialogue with federal, state and city officials BOEM lifted the order, and Equinor announced the resumption of construction at 00:18 CEST on 20 May 2025 (19 May in New York) (Equinor press releases).

The developer sued in the US District Court for the District of Columbia, which granted a preliminary injunction on 22 September 2025 allowing the affected work to restart while the case continued; Ørsted said construction would resume as soon as possible with safety first (Ørsted company announcement and news release).

summary: 2010 年商轉的 2 MW Vestas 機組火災，當日傍晚火勢受控；監察院 2026 年 7 月的調查報告引經濟部的研判：機艙內電氣設備短路故障起火，延燒整座機艙。

A 2 MW Vestas unit commissioned in 2010 caught fire and the blaze was under control by evening; the Control Yuan's July 2026 investigation report quotes the Ministry of Economic Affairs' judgement that a short circuit in electrical equipment inside the nacelle started the fire, which spread to the whole nacelle.

Control Yuan investigation report of 23 July 2026 (member Yeh Yi-chin), quoting the Ministry of Economic Affairs: the turbine was running normally with no alarm, no scheduled maintenance, no lightning and no temperature alarm, so the cause was judged to be a short-circuit fault of electrical equipment inside the nacelle; the report also finds that unit 17 had the most faults of the 23 turbines between January 2024 and April 2026 (over twice the average) and faults Taipower for not acting on it. The report gives phase 1 as 15 units commissioned in January 2009 and phase 2 as 8 units in May 2010 (unit 17 is in phase 2). The documents mention no casualties.

title: 波蘭第一座離岸風場 Baltic Power 首度送電，波蘭電網第一次收到離岸風電
Poland's first offshore wind farm, Baltic Power, delivers first power to the Polish grid
summary: 2026 年 7 月 10 日，ORLEN 宣布波蘭第一座波羅的海風場 Baltic Power 的電力首次進入波蘭電網；當時 76 部風機已裝好 54 部，第一部開始發電，預計秋季完工、容量逐步提高到 1.2 GW。合資方 Northland Power 同日說，這是波蘭電網第一次收到離岸風電；風場位於 Choczewo 與 Łeba 外海約 23 公里，使用 76 部 Vestas 15 MW 風機。

On 10 July 2026 ORLEN announced that electricity from Baltic Power, Poland's first wind farm in the Baltic Sea, had entered the national grid; 54 of its 76 turbines were installed and the first was generating, with construction due to finish in the autumn and capacity rising gradually to 1.2 GW. Partner Northland Power said the same day that this was the first offshore wind electricity ever delivered to Poland's grid; the farm lies about 23 km off Choczewo and Łeba with 76 Vestas 15 MW turbines.

title: 離岸二期統包商富崴董事會通過聲請破產，台電接管風機安裝
Taipower Offshore Phase 2's EPC contractor Fuwei resolves to file for bankruptcy; Taipower takes over turbine installation
summary: 台電離岸風電二期（31 部、294.5 MW）的統包商富崴能源（森崴能源子公司）2026 年 9 月 29 日召開記者會，表示工程虧損、資不抵債，董事會通過聲請破產，並要求台電先付保證金與保留款約 60 億元。Vestas 先前終止與富崴的安裝分包，富崴 6 月 3 日與 27 日兩度請台電接管，台電已與 Vestas 議約、9 月 28 日出海裝機；當時水下基礎與海纜全數完工，31 部風機只裝好 1 部，10 月初再完成 1 部。雙方另為富崴把 30 部風機設定動產抵押給母公司起爭議，金管會 10 月 6 日收到台電檢舉。中央社、聯合報與鉅亨網報導。

On 29 September 2026 Fuwei Energy (a Shinfox subsidiary), EPC contractor for Taipower Offshore Phase 2 (31 turbines, 294.5 MW), told a press conference that losses on the job had left it insolvent and its board had resolved to file for bankruptcy, demanding that Taipower first release about NT$6 billion in bonds and retentions. Vestas had earlier ended its installation subcontract with Fuwei, which twice asked Taipower (3 and 27 June) to take over; Taipower signed with Vestas and sailed on 28 September. All foundations and cables were complete but only 1 of 31 turbines had been installed, with one more added in early October. A further dispute arose over Fuwei's chattel mortgage of 30 turbines to its parent, which the Financial Supervisory Commission received a complaint about from Taipower on 6 October. Reported by CNA, United Daily News and Anue (cnyes).

Round 3.3 (3.6 GW) closes with only two bidders, Ørsted and CIP
summary: 能源署 2026 年 9 月 30 日公布離岸風電區塊開發 3-3 期收件截止：釋出 3.6 GW、2030–2031 年併網，只有沃旭（大肚一號）與 CIP（渢妙三）2 家投標。兩座場址幾乎完全重疊，依選商規則最後只會有一家獲配。本期恢復每度 2.29 元保底價、取消強制國產化改以 ESG 評分，經濟部長龔明鑫 4 月曾說有 5 家以上廠商來拜會。NOWnews 與經濟日報報導；得標結果尚待公布。

On 30 September 2026 the Energy Administration closed bidding for Round 3.3 (3.6 GW for grid connection in 2030–2031) with only two bids, Ørsted's Dadu 1 and CIP's Fengmiao 3. The two sites almost entirely overlap, so under the rules only one can win. The round restored a NT$2.29/kWh floor price and replaced mandatory local content with ESG scoring; in April the economics minister had said more than five companies had come to discuss it. Reported by NOWnews and the Economic Daily News; the result is still to be announced.

Blade damaged on one turbine a month after full operation; exclusion zone at sea
summary: 10 月 2 日中午大彰化西北離岸風場一部風機葉片損毀；沃旭能源說事發時風機無人作業、安全區域內無船舶，確認無人傷亡，附近海域已採安全管制並通報中央與地方主管機關，工作船待命，全場風機仍在西門子歌美颯保固期內、由其主導調查（中央社，2026-10-03）。

At noon on 2 October a blade on one turbine of the Greater Changhua Northwest (Changhua 4) offshore wind farm was damaged; Ørsted said no one was working on the turbine and no vessel was inside the safety zone, confirmed no casualties, set up a maritime exclusion zone, notified the central and local authorities and kept a work vessel on standby; all turbines are still under Siemens Gamesa warranty and SGRE leads the investigation (CNA, 3 Oct 2026).
